annotations.title: Mechanics Lien Notice and Filing Dates

description: Count mechanics lien (construction lien) notice and filing deadlines from the dates of a job. Send the last day you furnished labor or materials (and, if a step needs them, the first day, the date an owner's notice of completion or termination was recorded, or the date your lien was recorded), plus each step with the count YOUR state's statute gives: a number of days, a number of months, or a day of a later month (the Texas form '15th day of the 3rd month after the month the work was done'). Get back each deadline, its weekday, whether it falls on a weekend or US federal holiday, the next business day if you say your state extends such deadlines, and, with as_of, the days left or the days past. The tool does not know any state's counts: you send them. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/lien-deadline-dates). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

as_of.description: Optional: today's date (or any date), YYYY-MM-DD, to get days left or days past for each step.

completion_notice_date.description: Date the owner's notice of completion, cessation or termination was recorded, if a step counts from it, YYYY-MM-DD.

extra_holidays.description: Optional: your state's legal holidays that are not US federal holidays (up to 40 dates). They count as non-business days.

items.description: A state or local legal holiday, YYYY-MM-DD.

first_work_date.description: First day labor, services or materials were furnished (for preliminary-notice steps counted from the start), YYYY-MM-DD.

last_work_date.description: Last day labor, services or materials were furnished to the job, YYYY-MM-DD.

lien_recorded_date.description: Date your lien was recorded, if a step counts from it (an enforcement suit deadline, for example), YYYY-MM-DD.

steps.description: The deadlines to count (1 to 20), each with the count your state's statute gives.

count.description: The number from the statute: days (1 to 3650) or months (1 to 120).

day_of_month.description: Only for unit month_day: the day of that month (15 for 'the 15th day'); last day of the month when the month is shorter.

from.description: Which date the count starts from: last_work (default), first_work, completion_notice or lien_recorded.

step.description: Your name for the step, such as preliminary_notice, notice_of_intent, lien_filing, enforcement_suit (up to 4 digits in a row).

unit.description: days (N days after), months (same day N months after; last day of the month when that day does not exist), month_day (day_of_month of the Nth month after the month of the start date).

weekend_holiday_rule.description: none (default): the deadline stays on the counted day, even a weekend or holiday. next_business_day: only if YOUR state's time-computation statute extends a deadline that falls on a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday.
